description: Land Acquisition - Pepiliyana, Kesbewa D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette notice is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired for a development project, including lot numbers, land names, descriptions, claimants, and extents. The content focuses solely on land/property matters without any government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories, making it a clear Land Gazette (Type 4).
